custom.title: Registries + domains
custom.description: Package registries plus the domains you list.

full.title: Any public host
full.description: The whole internet, without local or private addresses.

packages.count: {count, plural, =0 {no packages} one {# package} other {# packages}}

settings.title: Sandbox
settings.description: Where agents run commands, install packages and create files.

status.title: Status
status.description: Checked by the worker at startup and after every save here.

isolation.runc: Standard containers: namespaces, seccomp, no capabilities.

status.unavailableHint: Agents get no workspace tools and local MCP servers do not start until this is fixed.

fix.dockerNotConfigured: The worker is not connected to Docker. Run it with docker compose, which sets SANDBOX_DOCKER_HOST and attaches it to the sandbox network (see DEPLOY.md).

status.noTools: No tools found in the sandbox.

enabled.title: Sandbox
enabled.description: A Docker container per workspace, where agents run commands and keep their files.

on.title: On
on.description: Agents get workspace tools and local MCP servers run.

off.title: Off
off.description: No workspace tools and no local MCP servers.

defaults.title: Default policy
defaults.description: For chats without a project and projects that follow the default.

limits.title: Limits
limits.description: How long one command may run.

docker.title: Containers
docker.description: Resources and runtime of each workspace container.

runsc.title: gVisor
runsc.description: A separate kernel per container. Needs runsc on the host.

docker.gvisorMissing: gVisor is not installed on this Docker host.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.summary: {pids} processes, pause after {pause} min, stop after {stop} h, chat workspaces kept {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
advanced.pidsHint: Most processes per container, from {min} to {max}.
advanced.pauseIdleHint: Minutes without commands before a container is paused, from {min} to {max}. A container with something still running in the background (a build, a server) is not paused.
advanced.stopIdleHint: Hours without commands before a container is stopped, with whatever still runs in it, from {min} to {max}.
advanced.retentionHint: Days a chat's unused workspace is kept before it is deleted with its files, from {min} to {max}.

project.title: Sandbox
project.description: Network access and packages of this project's workspace.
project.customDescription: Own network access and packages for this project.
project.resetDescription: Deletes the files, installed packages and caches of this project's workspace. The next run starts empty.
project.resetConfirmDescription: Every file in the workspace is deleted. Files already shared in chats stay downloadable.

mcp.title: Sandbox
mcp.description: Where the server process runs and what it can reach.
mcp.sandboxedHint: Isolated from the worker's files, with the network access set below.
mcp.unsandboxedWarning: The process runs directly in the worker, with the worker user's files and network. Only for trusted servers that need host state, such as a browser cache.
